Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:11:1.hebrew: בשקנו מידו - שאם יקלקל שמירתו ישלם, הא ודאי שלם, שהרי הוריד עצמו לכך ושיעבד נכסיו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:11:1.english: Where they performed an act of acquisition with him - [Meaning] that if he spoils his guarding, he will pay; [in] that [case] he certainly pays, for he has subjected himself to this and encumbered his property.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:12:1.hebrew: תני תנא - לענין שבועת הפקדון, אשם גזילות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:12:1.english: The tanna taught - Regarding the oath of deposit, [namely, the] guilt-offering for robbery.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:13:1.hebrew: קדשים שהבעלים חייבין באחריותן - כגון דאמר הרי עלי, והפרישן והפקידן לזה, וכפר ונשבע והודה — חייב קרבן שבועה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:13:1.english: Sacrificial [animals] for which the owners bear responsibility - For example, where [the owner] said, "It is incumbent upon me [to bring an offering]," and he set them aside and deposited them with this [bailee], and [the bailee] denied [it], took an oath [falsely], and [subsequently] confessed — he is liable [to bring] an oath-offering.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:13:2.hebrew: שאני קורא בהן בה' וכחש - קס"ד טעם דחיובא משום דהן של גבוה, קרינן בהו "ומעלה מעל בה' וכחש":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:13:2.english: As I read in their regard: “against the Lord, and deals falsely” - [The Gemara] initially assumed [that] the reason for liability is because they belong to the Most High, [so] we apply to them [the verse]: “and commits a trespass against the Lord, and deals falsely.”

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:13:3.hebrew: ושאינן חייבין הבעלים באחריותן פטור - הנשבע. שאני קורא בהן "בעמיתו וכחש", מפני שהם קרוין של עמיתו, ודעמיתו פטור, דבעינן "בה'":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:13:3.english: And [consecrated animals] for whose responsibility the owners are not liable, [one] is exempt - [meaning] the one who swears [falsely regarding them]. "For I read regarding them: 'with his neighbor, and deals falsely'" — because they are called "of his neighbor," and [regarding] that of his neighbor one is exempt, for we require "against the Lord."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:14:1.hebrew: כלפי לייא - כלפי היכן הדבר נוטה. לייא — היכא, כגון (ברכות דף נח.): חצבי לנהרא, כגני לייא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:14:1.english: Kelapei layya - Toward where does the matter incline? Layya [means] "where," as in (Berakhot 58a): "[The intact] jugs [go] to the river; where [do] the broken [jugs go]?"

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:1:1.hebrew: נשבעין לגזברים - שלא פשעו בהן, שהן בעלי הדין. דמכיון שתרמו את הלשכה, אין אחריות אבידה על הבעלים אלא על ההקדש, כדאמרינן לקמן: תורמין על האבוד — שיהא חלק בקופות הללו למי ששלח שקלו ואבד, ואינו יודע עכשיו שאבד:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:1:1.english: They take the oath to the treasurers - [To swear] that they were not negligent with them, for they [the treasurers] are the litigants. Since once they have separated [funds from] the chamber, the responsibility for loss is not upon the owners, but rather upon the consecrated property [of the Temple], as we say later: "They separate [funds] on behalf of that which is lost" — that there should be a share in these baskets for one who sent his shekel and it was lost, and he does not know now that it was lost.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:1:2.hebrew: ואם לאו - שנודע להם מקודם לכן, שוב אין תורמין עליהם אלא על מנת שישלחו להם אחרים תחתיהם; לפיכך, בני העיר הן בעלי הדין של שלוחים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:1:2.english: And if not - [If] it became known to them before then [that the shekels were lost], they no longer separate [the chamber funds] on their behalf except on condition that they send others in their place; therefore, the residents of the city are the litigants against the agents.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:1:3.english: They were found - [This] refers to "they were lost."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:1:4.english: That [the thieves] returned them - [This] refers to "they were stolen."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:1:5.english: These and those are shekels - For once they have become consecrated, they remain consecrated.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:2:1.hebrew: הכא בנושא שכר עסקינן - כלומר, שבועה זו לא ליפטר מתשלומין היא, דלאו שומר חנם נשבע על הפשיעה ולא נושא שכר משלם גניבה ואבידה כי מתני'. ושבועה זו, כדי ליטול שכרן נשבעין שאינן ברשותן, וגובין שכרן מן בני העיר. ולקמיה פריך: והא כיון דשומר שכר יש עליו לשומרו מגניבה ואבידה ולא שמר, לא השלים עבודתו, אין לו ליטול שכר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:2:1.english: Here we are dealing with a paid bailee - That is to say, this oath is not to be exempted from payment, for [it is] neither an unpaid bailee [who] swears regarding negligence nor a paid bailee [who] pays for theft and loss as [in] our Mishnah. And [as for] this oath — in order to collect their wages, they swear that [the coins] are not in their possession, and they collect their wages from the residents of the city. And later [the Gemara] asks: But since a paid bailee is obligated to guard it from theft and loss and he did not guard [it], he did not complete his work [and] does not have [the right] to collect wages.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:2:2.hebrew: נשבעים לגזברים - בתמיה, והלא אין שכרן אלא על בני העיר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:2:2.english: They take an oath to the treasurers - [This is said] as a question: are their wages not [owed] only by the residents of the city?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:2:3.hebrew: נשבעים לבני העיר - ליטול שכרן, ובמעמד הגזברים מפני שההפסד על ההקדש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:2:3.english: They take an oath to the residents of the city - to collect their wages, and in the presence of the treasurers because the loss is upon the Temple treasury.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:3:1.english: And here too, although they do not pay - For consecrated property is excluded from bailee payments.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:3:2.hebrew: אגרייהו מיהא לפסיד - שהרי נשתעבדו לשומרן מגניבה ואבידה, ועל מנת כן היו נוטלין שכר, והרי לא השלימו מלאכתן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:3:2.english: Let them at least forfeit their wages - For they obligated themselves to guard them against theft and loss, and it was on that condition that they were taking wages, and behold, they did not complete their work.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:4:1.hebrew: בלסטים מזוין - דאונס הוי, ולשמירה זו לא קבלו עליהם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:4:1.english: By armed bandits - For [this] is an unavoidable accident, and they did not accept upon themselves [responsibility] for this [level of] safeguarding.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:5:1.hebrew: הא מני ר"ש היא - במסכת שבועות (דף מב:):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:5:1.english: Whose [opinion] is this? It is [that of] Rabbi Shimon - In Tractate Shevuot (42b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:5:2.hebrew: יש להן אונאה - בכדי גרס לה, ומאן דגריס לה לא ידע שאמר ר"ש בהדיא לגבי שבועה, והוצרך ללמדה ממשנתנו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:5:2.english: They are subject to exploitation - [This phrase] is included in the text unnecessarily, and the one who recites it did not know that Rabbi Shimon stated [it] explicitly with regard to an oath, and [therefore] needed to derive it from our Mishnah.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:5:3.hebrew: שחייב באחריות - שהמפקיד חייב באחריות, הלכך כדידיה דמי לר"ש. והכא נמי חייבין כל בני העיר לשקול אחרים תחתיהן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:5:3.english: For which one bears responsibility - [Meaning] that the depositor bears responsibility [for them]; therefore, it is considered like his own according to Rabbi Shimon. And here too, all the townspeople are obligated to pay others in their place.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:6:1.hebrew: תורמין על האבוד - כשהיו ממלאים שלש קופות מכסף הלשכה, והיא תרומה ליקח מכסף הקופות כל קרבנות צבור, ותורמין אותן ע"מ שיהו שלש קופות ראש ותרומה לשיריים, שיהו אותן שהביאו שקלים הנשארים בלשכה זוכים בתרומת הקופה להיות הקרבנות גם עליהם. ותורמין אותן אע"פ ששלח שקלו ואבד לו ואין ידוע לו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:6:1.english: One separates [the contribution] for that which is lost - When they would fill three baskets from the money of the [Temple] chamber — and that is the [chamber] separation, to purchase from the money in the baskets all the communal offerings — they would separate them on condition that the three baskets be the primary [portion] and a separation for the remainder, so that those who brought the shekels that remain in the chamber acquire a share in the separation of the basket, [such] that the offerings be on their behalf as well. And they separate them even though [a person] sent his shekel and it was lost to him, and it is not known to him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:6:2.english: And for that which is collected - and it is still on the way.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:6:3.hebrew: ועל העתיד לגבות - מי שנאנס ולא שלח שקלו באדר, היה משלחו כל השנה כולה, ונותנין בשופר שכתוב עליו תקלין חדתין. והלשכה היתה נתרמה ג' פעמים בשנה: בפרוס הפסח, ובפרוס עצרת, ובפרוס החג. וכשמגיע זמן לתרום, נותנין מעות השופר בלשכה ותורמין. וכשתורמין תרומה ראשונה, מתנין אף על העתיד לגבות, וגם בשניה ובשלישית. והמביא אחר שנתרמה השלישית, נותנו לשופר ששמו תיקלין עתיקין, ונופל לשירי הלשכה, ומהן באין חומת העיר ומגדלותיה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:6:3.english: And for [that which is] destined to be collected - One who was prevented by unavoidable circumstances and did not send his shekel in Adar would send it throughout the entire year, and they would place [it] in a shofar[-shaped chest] upon which was written "New Shekels" [tiklin chadatin]. And the [Temple] chamber had [its funds] separated three times a year: shortly before Passover, shortly before Shavuot [Atzeret], and shortly before Sukkot [HaChag]. And when the time arrived to separate [the funds], they would place the coins of the shofar[-shaped chest] into the chamber and separate [the contribution]. And when they separated the first contribution, they would stipulate [that it also counts] for [what is] destined to be collected, and likewise at the second and at the third [separations]. And one who brought [his shekel] after the third [contribution] had been separated would place it in the shofar[-shaped chest] whose name was "Old Shekels" [tiklin atikin], and it would fall to the remainder of the chamber, and from them [came the funds for] the wall of the city and its towers.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:7:1.hebrew: אלא אר"א - לעולם שבועה זו ליפטר מן התשלומין היא, ובשומר חנם. ודקשיא לך מתני' — דאורייתא פטור לגמרי, ורבנן הוא דתקון לה שלא יזלזלו בהקדשות בשמירתן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:7:1.english: Rather, Rabbi Elazar said - Actually, this oath is [taken] to be exempt from payment, and [it refers to] an unpaid bailee. And regarding your difficulty [from] the Mishnah — by Torah law he is completely exempt, and it was the Sages who instituted it so that [people] would not treat consecrated property lightly in their safeguarding [of it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:8:1.english: One who hires laborers - [This refers to] a treasurer of the Temple treasury who hired laborers with [funds] of the Temple treasury.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:8:2.hebrew: לשמור את הפרה - אדומה שלקחוה, ושומרין אותה שלא תיפסל בעליית עול או במום:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:8:2.english: To watch the heifer - [A] red [heifer] that they purchased, and they watch it so that it does not become disqualified through a yoke being placed [upon it] or through a blemish.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:8:3.hebrew: לשמור את התינוקות - שלא יטמאו, שהיו מגדלין אותן לפרה בחצירות הבנויות בסלעים ותחתיהן חלל, כדאמרינן בסוכה בהישן תחת המטה (דף כא.), לפי שעשו מעלה בכהן השורף את הפרה שתהא פרישתו בטהרה, ואין אחיו הכהנים נוגעין בו כל שבעה, כדאמרינן בסדר יומא (דף ח:). והתינוקות הללו, שלא נטמאו מעולם, ממלאים מים למקדשין ומזין עליו כל שבעה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:8:3.english: To watch the children - So that they would not become ritually impure, for they used to raise them for [the rite of] the [Red] Heifer in courtyards built upon rocks with a hollow space beneath them, as we say in [Tractate] Sukkah, in [the chapter] HaYashen Tachat HaMitah (21a), because they instituted a stringency for the priest who burns the [Red] Heifer that his separation be in purity, and his brother priests do not touch him all seven [days], as we say in Seder Yoma (8b). And these children, who had never become ritually impure, would draw water for those who sanctify [the purification water] and sprinkle [it] upon him all seven [days].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:8:4.hebrew: ולשמור הזרעים - שדה המבכרת וזרועה לעומר קודם לפסח שבעים יום, כדאמרינן במנחות (דף פה.). אי נמי, בשביעית — ספיחים לעומר ושתי הלחם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:8:4.english: And to watch the seeds - [This refers to] a field that ripens early and is sown for the omer seventy days before Passover, as we say in Menachot (85a). Alternatively, in the Sabbatical year, [it refers to guarding] aftergrowths [sefiḥim] for the omer and the Two Loaves.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:8:5.english: They do not give him wages for Shabbat - If he is a day laborer.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:8:6.hebrew: לפיכך אין אחריות שבת עליו - אם אירע בהן קלקול בשבת, אין חייב לשלם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:8:6.english: Therefore, responsibility for Shabbat is not upon him - If damage occurred to them on Shabbat, he is not obligated to pay.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:9:1.english: Hired for a Sabbath - [That is,] a week.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:9:2.english: Hired for seven years - A complete Sabbatical [cycle].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 58a:9:3.english: They give him wages for Shabbat - For it is absorbed into the wages of the other days and is not specified [separately] for Shabbat.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 58a:11:1.hebrew: אמר רבי יוחנן בשקנו מידו - וא"ת, דבפ' הפועלים (לקמן בבא מציעא ד' צד. ע"ש) תנא: מתנה שומר חנם להיות כשואל להתחייב באונסין, ופריך: במאי מתנה, בדברים? ומשני: אמר שמואל בשקנו מידו, ור' יוחנן אמר: אפילו תימא לא קנו מידו, בההוא הנאה דקא מהימן ליה גמר ומשעבד נפשיה. א"כ, מאי בעי קנין? וי"ל, דהכא דפטור אפי' משבועה — לא משעבד נפשיה בלא קנין. אי נמי: התם, כיון שמתחייב כשואל, סבורים העולם שהשאיל לו, ובההיא הנאה משעבד נפשיה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 58a:11:1.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan said: Where they performed an act of acquisition with him - And if you ask: In the chapter [entitled] HaPoalim (later in Bava Metzia 94a, see there), it was taught: "An unpaid bailee may stipulate to be like a borrower, to become liable for unavoidable accidents." And [the Gemara] asks: "With what does he stipulate — with [mere] words?" And [the Gemara] answers: "Shmuel said: Where they performed an act of acquisition with him. And Rabbi Yoḥanan said: You may even say [that] they did not perform an act of acquisition with him; through that benefit that [the owner] trusts him, he resolves and obligates himself." If so, why does [Rabbi Yoḥanan here] require an act of acquisition? And one can answer: Here, where he is exempt even from an oath, he does not obligate himself without an act of acquisition. Alternatively: There, since he obligates himself like a borrower, people assume that [the owner] lent [the item] to him, and through that benefit he obligates himself.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 58a:1:1.hebrew: נשבעין לגזברים - פרש"י: אם משנתרמה התרומה באו לדין — נשבעים לגזברים, דתנן: "תורמין על האבוד". משמע שרוצה לפרש "תורמין על האבוד" — שאבדו שליח קודם שנתרמה, אך לא באו לדין אלא אחר שתרמו. וקשה לפירושו, דהוה ליה "זו ואין צ"ל זו", דכ"ש על הגבוי שלא נאבד שתורמין עליו; וגם הפשט לא מיירי בבואם לדין. ויש לפרש: "תורמין על האבוד" — שבא ליד הגזבר ונאבד קודם שתרמו, כיון שהגיע ליד הגזבר; ו"על הגבוי" — ועודנו ביד השליח בדרך, תורמין אע"ג שנאבד אחר שתרמו; ו"על העתיד לגבות" — אחר זמן ולשולחו לגזבר, אע"פ שבשעת הרמה לא נתנה עדיין לשליח. ובפרק בתרא דכתובות (ד' קח. ושם ד"ה ועל) גבי מודר הנאה, דפריך: "בשלמא שוקל שקלו, דתנן: תורמין על האבוד כו'" — פירוש: אותו שנאבד משליח אחר שתרמו, דאין זה הנאה כיון שהוא פטור; ולא כפרש"י דהתם, דפי' דמעתיד לגבות מוכיח דתורמין אע"פ שלא יגבה לעולם — ואין משמע כן בשמעתין:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 58a:1:1.english: They take an oath to the treasurers - Rashi explained [that] if [the agents] came to court after the contribution [of the chamber] had been collected, they take an oath to the treasurers, as we learned in the Mishnah: "They collect [the half-shekel contribution] on behalf of that which was lost." It appears that he wants to explain "they collect on behalf of that which was lost" [as referring to money] that an agent lost before it was collected, [and the reason the Mishnah says "if after the collection"] is only that they did not come to court until after [the treasurers] had collected. However, [there is] a difficulty with his explanation: for [according to Rashi, the Mishnah] would be [an example of] "this, and needless to say that" — for all the more so [is it true] regarding that which was collected [and] not lost that they collect on its behalf! And furthermore, the plain meaning [of the Mishnah] is not speaking of when they come to court. Rather, one should explain: "They collect on behalf of that which was lost" — [this refers to money] that came into the hand of the treasurer and was lost before they collected, since it [already] reached the hand of the treasurer; and "on behalf of that which was collected" — while it is still in the hand of the agent on the way, they collect [on its behalf] even though it was lost after they collected; and "on behalf of that which is destined to be collected" — [collected] later on and sent to the treasurer, even though at the time of the collection it had not yet been given to the agent. And in the last chapter of Ketubot (108a, and there, s.v. Ve'al), regarding one who is forbidden by a vow from benefiting [from another], where [the Gemara] asks: "It is understandable [that] he may pay his half-shekel [for him], as we learned in the Mishnah: 'They collect on behalf of that which was lost,' etc." — [its] explanation [is that it refers to] that which was lost from an agent after they collected, for this is not a benefit [to the owner] since he is [already] exempt; and [it is] not like Rashi's explanation there, who explained that from "destined to be collected" [the Gemara] proves that they collect even though it will never be collected — for that is not implied in our passage:

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 58a:6:1.hebrew: דתנן תורמין על כו' - דתניא גרסינן, דאין זו משנה בשקלים. ותימה: אמאי לא מוכח מגופא דאינו חייב באחריות, מדקאמר "נשבעין לגזברין ולא לבני העיר":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 58a:6:1.english: "As we learned: One collects for, etc." - We read [the text as] detanya ["as it is taught in a baraita"], for this is not a Mishnah in [Tractate] Shekalim. And it is astonishing: why does [the Gemara] not prove from [the teaching] itself that one does not bear responsibility [for them], from the fact that it states, "They take an oath to the Temple treasurers, and not to the residents of the city"?

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 58a:8:1.hebrew: לשמור הזרעים - וא"ת: והיאך מותר לעומר כיון ששומר? הא כתיב (יחזקאל מה): "ממשקה ישראל" — מן המותר לישראל, ודרשינן (ת"כ פ' בהר): "ואת ענבי נזיריך לא תבצור" — מן המשומר אי אתה בוצר, אבל אתה בוצר מן ההפקר; משמע דאסור אם ליקט מן המשומר. וכי תימא: אינו אסור כי אם לבצור, אבל אם עבר ובצר שרי לאכול — הא אפילו מן ההפקר אסור לבצור, דבצירה תולדה דקצירה, כדאמרינן בריש מועד קטן (ד' ג.). וי"ל שלא היה מוחה לעולם מליקח, רק שהיה מודיען שיחדום לעומר, ומעצמן היו נמנעין מליקח:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 58a:8:1.english: To safeguard the seeds - And if you ask: How is it permitted for the omer [offering], since he is guarding [them during the Sabbatical year]? Behold, it is written (Ezekiel 45): "From the drink of Israel" — [meaning] from that which is permitted to Israel, and we expound (Torat Kohanim, Parashat Behar): "And the grapes of your untrimmed vine you shall not gather" — from that which is guarded you may not gather, but you may gather from that which is ownerless; [this] implies that it is forbidden if one gathered from that which is guarded. And if you should say [that] it is only forbidden to gather [in the normal manner], but if one transgressed and gathered [it], it is permitted to eat — behold, even from that which is ownerless it is forbidden to gather [in the normal manner], for gathering [grapes] is a derivative [toladah] of reaping, as we say at the beginning of Moed Katan (3a). And one can answer that he would not protest against anyone taking [from them]; rather, he would only inform them that they had been designated for the omer, and on their own [people] would refrain from taking.
